items.title: GM brings back Apple CarPlay as buyers demand it
items.summary: GM is bringing Apple CarPlay and Android Auto back to its vehicles, reversing one of the more unpopular decisions in the automaker's recent history.

items.title: GM is re-downloading Apple CarPlay, Android Auto to its cars
items.summary: General Motors (GM) will reinstall Apple's (AAPL) CarPlay and Android Auto in its vehicles after initially planning to remove the software from new cars. Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian explains the consumer reaction that led to this decision.

items.title: Ford Motor vs. Stellantis: Which Automotive Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: Ford is paying a dividend while its turnaround plays out. Stellantis is still working toward positive free cash flow and doesn't expect to get there until 2027. The difference in financial footing tells the whole story.

items.title: Automaker Stocks Reverse as Rotation Trade Unwinds: General Motors and Stellantis Fall 4%, Ford Pulls Back
items.summary: Thursday's rotation rally handed automakers a one-day reprieve from months of pressure, but Friday morning that same trade ran straight into reverse, and the order in which Stellantis, GM, and Ford are falling tells the whole story.

items.title: Ford’s Yield Is One of the Loudest in the Market. Is the Payout Actually Safe?
items.summary: Ford's dividend yield screams louder than almost anything else on the market right now, but trailing yield screens are hiding something important about what investors are actually collecting. Before you buy for income, there are two numbers that determine whether this payout survives 2026.
